---
name: visual-regression-review
description: 'Run an independent visual review of an implemented ClipYantra page/component against approved designs at multiple viewports.'
agent: visual-qa-reviewer
---

Use `visual-qa`.

Inspect the rendered page, not only source code. Check approved layout, type, spacing, colors/tokens, hierarchy, state coverage, interaction, media/timeline behavior, responsive overflow and consistency. Capture screenshots at agreed desktop and compact viewports. Run available browser/component tests and accessibility automation. Report reproducible findings by severity with screenshot/evidence references. Do not modify implementation or accept screenshot baselines to hide unexplained differences. Finish `PASS`, `BLOCKED` or `NEEDS FIXES`.
